scope: Four lighting themes, each clean background + transparent flowering plants, nonflowering grass, basalt and particles. Full-frame layers for actual browser reassembly.

jobs.label: 노을
jobs.prompt:
Use case: background-extraction / precise-object-edit. This is a strict LAYER SEPARATION of the attached completed panoramic Jeju fantasy OIL PAINTING, not a redesign. Preserve the EXACT original canvas framing, x/y positions, apparent object sizes, flower count, botanical species, colors, light direction and thick broken brushstrokes. Output one full-width 3:1 landscape PNG at the original framing, target 2172x724. Do not crop to object bounds, zoom, center or rearrange objects: keep empty areas as transparent space at their original canvas coordinates. No labels, text, border, diagram, collage or checkerboard pixels. The objective is to stack separate layers back together at x=0,y=0 without relocating anything.
REQUESTED LAYER: Background
Produce ONLY the opaque CLEAN BACKGROUND PLATE: same sky, cloud shapes, Hallasan mountain silhouette, sun or moon, layered distant ridges, mist and spacious open ground. REMOVE every foreground flower, its stems and leaves, all distinctive near grass tufts/leaf clusters, every near basalt stone, and all added luminous particle motes/glints from the air and ground. Inpaint the revealed lower foreground with a quiet continuous painterly meadow/earth surface in the same perspective and local lighting; no separate near plants or rocks. Keep the original background details above the flower bed as closely as possible. No white blank areas. Fully opaque background. This must let near flowers, grass and rocks be added as independent layers later.
